examples.text: yāva'd'eva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā'ti.
methunam'anuyuttassa, vighātaṃ brūhi mārisa, sutvāna tava sāsanaṃ, viveke sikkhissāmase.
addasā kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo sāvatthiyaṃ sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ itthiṃ mūḷhagabbhaṃ vighātagabbhaṃ disvān'assa etadahosi, kilissanti vata, bho, sattā, kilissanti vata, bho, sattā'ti!

67392.meaning1: having a life-threatening birth; having a disastrous delivery

examples.text: addasā kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo sāvatthiyaṃ sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ itthiṃ mūḷhagabbhaṃ vighātagabbhaṃ disvān'assa etadahosi, kilissanti vata, bho, sattā, kilissanti vata, bho, sattā'ti!
byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.

vicikicchā-nīvaraṇaṃ, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.

67395.meaning1: troublesome and afflictive; annoying and uncomfortable
67395.commentary: (MNa) āsavā vighātapariḷāhā'ti cattāro āsavā ca aññe ca vighātakarā kilesapariḷāhā vipākapariḷāhā ca.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye kāyasamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, kāyasamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

ye ca pāṇ'ātipātapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, pāṇ'ātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. apāṇ'ātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇ'ātipāto pahātabbo'ti, iti yan'taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mah'iccho hoti vighātavā asantuṭṭho itarītara-cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena

67397.commentary: (MNa) vighātavā'ti savighāto sadukkho. (ANa) vighātavā'ti mah'icchāpaccayena vighātena dukkhena samannāgato.

examples.text: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anupādā paritassanā hoti.
